Task_order.Description: Order in which experimental tasks were administered; 1=card, 2=eyes, 3=gradCPT, 4=movies, 5=nBack, 6=SST. The tasks are preceded by one rest run and followed by another rest run. NOTE: If a task is labeled 7, it should be ignored as it represents a trial run, and that trial run was not shared as a part of this dataset.

Task_difficulty_nback.Description: Self-reported difficulty rating for the nBack task

Task_difficulty_SST.Description: Self-reported difficulty rating for the SST task

Task_difficulty_card.Description: Self-reported difficulty rating for the card task

Task_difficulty_gradCPT.Description: Self-reported difficulty rating for the gradCPT task

Task_difficulty_eyes.Description: Self-reported difficulty rating for the eyes task

Task_difficulty_movie.Description: Self-reported difficulty rating for the movies task

Task_engagement_wm.Description: Self-reported engagement rating during the nBack task

Task_engagement_SST.Description: Self-reported engagement rating during the SST task

Task_engagement_card.Description: Self-reported engagement rating during the cards task

Task_engagement_gradCPT.Description: Self-reported engagement rating during the gradCPT task

Task_engagement_eyes.Description: Self-reported engagement rating during the eyes task

Task_engagement_movies.Description: Self-reported engagement rating during the movies task

SleepRuns.Description: Self-reported runs that the participant slept during (R1= rest run 1, R2= rest run 2)

eyes_words_DK.Description: Participants are shown a list of potential words that may be shown in the emotional eyes task, prior to the MRI session. Participants mark the words that they do not know the meaning of, and the research assistant reads out the meaning of the word to them. The words that the participant had marked as not knowing the meaning of are recorded.
